title: Precision Medicine, AI, and the Future of Personalized Health Care

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and precision medicine promises to revolutionize health care.

evidence.text: The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and precision medicine promises to revolutionize health care.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Precision Medicine, AI, and the Future of Personalized Health Care》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Precision medicine methods identify phenotypes of patients with less-common responses to treatment or unique healthcare needs.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Recent literature suggests that translational research exploring this convergence will help solve the most difficult challenges facing precision medicine, especially those in which nongenomic and genomic determinants, combined with information from patient symptoms, clinical history, and lifestyles, will facilitate personalized diagnosis and prognostication.
